name: E-XD-series infiltrator droid
description: The E-XD-series infiltrator droid, also known more simply as E-XD infiltrator droid, was a model of recon droid used by the Galactic Empire. EXD-9 was an Imperial infiltrator droid who infiltrated the Phoenix Cell's Chopper Base on Atollon.
